endpoint: next-year recorded Thalassia loss among source-year recorded-positive stable transects
scientific_question: Is out-of-time next-year recorded-loss discrimination from quantitative state distinct from stable transect identity, or mainly explained by persistently low-quality nodes?
source_cohort: exact analysis/09_quantitative_early_warning.py build_transitions; no new outcome eligibility, exclusions, folds, training minimums or loss labels

arms.space: frozen longitude, latitude, year, season, effort and water-body
arms.space_quant: space + source-year focal frequency and Braun-Blanquet
arms.node: space + stable node_id as one-hot categorical predictor
arms.node_quant: node + the identical two quantitative state predictors

model: same StandardScaler + OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore') + LogisticRegression(C=1.0,max_iter=2000), no hyperparameter search
year_scoring: strict target-year walk-forward, train target_year < scored target year; >=5 past loss transitions and >=50 past persistent transitions
primary: paired 23-target-year macro log-loss improvement from node to node+quant; 2016 included
secondary: pooled log-loss/AUC/Brier on the exactly matched predictions
23 target-year wins and year-level paired Wilcoxon, directional test
sensitivity omitting 2016 but not replacing primary
legacy space arms must reproduce frozen early-warning primary (570 predictions, 19 losses, 17/23 win years)
performance of node-only vs original space-only reference as diagnostic
support: A positive incremental condition warning requires node+quant lower macro log loss than node reference AND >=16/23 scored years improved AND one-sided year sign test p<0.05. Outcome-exposed reference saturation remains developmental and may only constrain interpretation of existing early-warning claim.
boundary: A recorded absence at next survey is not plant death, demographic extinction or loss of all rhizomes.
Fixed node identity is a categorical proxy for persistent site qualities; it does not explain physical mechanisms.
The 2016 target year is retained even if adverse.
The node+quant predictor can still reflect within-node detection sampling variation, not physiological decline.
Results cannot retrospectively redefine or erase the previously frozen space-only comparator; report both hierarchies.
No model/threshold/target-year tuning after observing outputs.
